name: zviryatko/frame
description: Base theme with a visual page builder over the Single Directory Components of your theme. React for the editor and for interactive components, with a shared Vite/Jest config for subthemes.

suggest.drupal/paragraphs: Paragraph types as blocks of the page builder, with the Paragraphs Library for reused ones (recipe frame_builder_paragraphs)
suggest.drupal/entity_usage: Shows where media, paragraphs and saved blocks are used by layouts (recipe frame_builder_paragraphs)
suggest.drupal/field_group: Groups of the form of a content type as panels of the page builder, each with its own button (recipe frame_builder_field_group)
suggest.drupal/metatag: Meta tags on landing pages, filled by the AI assistant on request (recipe frame_builder_seo)
suggest.drupal/views_better_rest: ^1.3: a view as the JSON API of an interactive component, with its exposed filters, sorts and pager; also for Search API views with Facets
suggest.drupal/ai: The AI assistant of the page builder (recipe frame_builder_ai)
